# bicep/recorder/main.bicep

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Storage account for recorded runs, with Entra-only access and tiering that never deletes.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `location` | string | `deployment().location` | Region for the run store. |
| `resourceGroupName` | string | `'avdlz-runs-rg'` | Resource group for the run store, independent of any landing zone name prefix. |
| `storageAccountName` | string |  | Storage account name (Initialize-AvdRunStore.ps1 derives it from the subscription). |
| `operatorPrincipalId` | string |  | Object ID of the operator who records runs: Storage Blob Data Contributor on this account only. |
| `operatorPrincipalType` | string | `'User'` | Principal type of the operator. |
| `teardownLogs` | string | `'Keep'` | What teardown does with a run folder by default: Keep (default), Ask or Delete (only after a verified copy). |
| `privateRepo` | string | `''` |  |
| `exportActivityLog` | bool | `true` | Send the subscription Activity Log to the run store, so it outlives the 90 days Azure keeps it. |
| `deadlineRunbookUri` | string | `''` |  |
| `tags` | object | `{}` | Extra tags merged onto the resource group and the storage account. |
